Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the WebSurfer’s search results. The SERP snippet supported Yi Guan’s work on SARS (identifying civet-to-human transmission) but did not provide evidence that his research “helped to prevent the outbreak” of H5N1. The Planner conflated SARS-related findings with avian influenza prevention, switched the target disease to HPAI A(H5N1) without corroborating sources, and prematurely declared the task complete, failing to verify the required explicit linkage.
